D: A group of young ranch hands become outlaws after their mentor is murdered in New Mexico.
P: Serve the mains when Tunstall's boys sit down at his ranch table.
S: the English rancher who teaches the boys manners
Cucumber and butter, and ham and mustard sandwiches, crusts off, cut into triangles, a proper English touch on a New Mexico ranch.
Roasted green chillies chopped into a hot cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with garlic, with tortilla chips.
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated in Worcestershire, pepper and chilli, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot and potato added with toasted dried red chillies and stock, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Warm flour tortillas.
Pork shoulder in chunks browned, braised 2.5 hours with roasted green chillies, tomatillos, onion, garlic and cumin until it falls apart, served over rice.
W: Butter and sugar creamed with aniseed, flour worked in, rolled and cut into stars, dipped in cinnamon sugar, baked at 175C for 10 minutes until pale gold.
K: 45ml rye whisky poured neat into small glasses, a jug of water on the table.

s.note: the English rancher who teaches the boys manners
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g ham and English mustard. Cut off the crusts and cut into triangles for a proper English touch on a New Mexico ranch.

Roast 3 green chillies until blackened, peel and chop. Warm 375ml evaporated milk with a crushed garlic clove, stir in 250g grated cheddar until smooth, then add the chillies. Serve hot with a 300g bag of corn chips.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced pork shoulder. Char 4 green chillies and 400g tomatillos, then blitz with an onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin. Braise the pork in the sauce for 2.5 hours until it falls apart. Serve over 300g rice.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar and 1 tsp crushed aniseed, then work in 300g flour. Roll out and cut into stars. Dip the tops in sugar mixed with cinnamon and bake at 175C for 10 minutes until pale gold.

d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky neat into each of four small glasses. Put a jug of water on the table. Sip slowly while the Regulators plan their next move.
